<h1>Chord Edit (Voicing Mask)</h1>

## Purpose

While the chord progression decides *which chord* plays each bar, chord
edit decides *which of that chord's 8 scale-row notes each sequencer
actually plays*. A sequencer driving a bass can play just the root while one driving a pad synth
plays all eight rows.

## Interaction

8×8 grid split into per-sequencer columns of 8 rows. Pressing a pad
toggles whether that scale row contributes to the built chord for that
sequencer (lit = contributing). Both players see the same view and write
to the same shared masks.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press a pad | LP grid | Toggle that scale row on/off in the sequencer's chord voicing | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE / SHIFT + SOLO | LP grid | **No-op**: deliberately excluded from reset/randomise | any |
